{{Quote|Ever notice how some people always seem as fresh as Jovarian sun ferns, even after the most demanding day? Or what about those who brave the heat of Varadan's twin suns and never seem to perspire?|Advertisement for the CSC-5000 body glove in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
'''Varadan''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. It [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Binary star/Legends|two stars]] and was very [[Temperature/Legends|hot]]. Controlled by the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region, it served as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world and employed [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] labor.

==Description==
Varadan was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Varadan system/Legends|Varadan system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Situated in the the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] area known as [[the Tangles]], it was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Kamur system/Legends|Kamur]] and [[Usnia system/Legends|Usnia systems]]. Varadan [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] and was intensely [[Temperature/Legends|hot]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> an advertisement for the [[Kamperdine Clothing Specialists/Legends|Kamperdine Clothing Specialists']] climate-controlled [[CSC-5000]] [[Body glove/Legends|body glove]] in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]'' made a rhetorical inquiry of whether the [[Datalog/Legends|datalog's]] reader had noticed individuals who did not appear to sweat despite enduring the heat of Varadan's [[Star/Legends|suns]], with the implication that such people were using the CSC-5000.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Inhabitants==
Like the rest of the Senex-Juvex worlds, Varadan was under the control of the region's [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]]. It served as a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world and had the reputation of being one of the harshest sites of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] labor in the Senex-Juvex.<ref name="TEA" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Varadan was first mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
